status: PROPOSED — pending owner approval (D3); not legal advice
notes: One shared engine (desk/_tools/engines/marketgate.mjs) evaluates each market against its own configuration. Thresholds are freshness limits tied to each source's publication rhythm, not performance thresholds; no statistic has a pass value. Legal topics are questions for counsel, not conclusions.

statistics.name: Residential sales, Istanbul province (monthly)
statistics.why: Activity level and direction; required before any statement about market activity.
statistics.fallback: Gate fails; no activity statements until published data are recorded.

statistics.name: Residential sales to foreign nationals, Istanbul province (monthly)
statistics.why: Foreign-buyer demand is directly relevant to Desk's audience and to resale liquidity.

statistics.name: Residential Property Price Index, Istanbul (monthly)
statistics.why: Price direction from an official index (valuation-based; an index, not a price level).

publishers: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye

statistics.fallback: Gate fails; never replaced by listing prices.

statistics.name: Consumer price inflation, annual (monthly)
statistics.why: Nominal TRY figures are not comparable over time without inflation context.

statistics.name: CBRT one-week repo (policy) rate
statistics.why: Financing conditions and the opportunity cost of capital in TRY.

publishers: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye

statistics.name: CBRT indicative USD/TRY rate
statistics.why: FX convention: TRY figures are converted only at a dated CBRT indicative rate.

publishers: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye

statistics.fallback: Gate fails; no conversion is shown.

fx.convention: CBRT indicative buying rate on the observation date of the converted figure; maximum age 7 days (CNV-1); no cross rates; conflicting rates open a conflict and block the gate.

activation_rule: A market may become ACTIVE only through `ingest.mjs activate-market --by owner`, which re-computes this gate and refuses unless (a) the computed gate passes for that market and (b) the registry entry M-MARKET-GATE is ACTIVE with RULES_APPROVED (owner approval of these rules). Each market is evaluated independently; one market's result never holds another.

review_record.rule: Only these records count as legal review. Evidence, research blocks or LEGAL FACT evidence are never treated as legal approval.
